title: Goblins!
description: Gin rummy against five goblins in a row. Draw, take the discard, or ask a goblin for a rank you hold; it must hand one over, or you go fish and get bitten. Knock at 10 deadwood or go gin, and the points hit the goblin. Goblins ask back, remember what you take and knock on their own terms. Your health lasts the whole run; trinkets between goblins bend the rules.
controls: Tap a card, then DRAW, TAKE, ASK, DISCARD or KNOCK. Keys: left and right pick a card; when drawing, up draws, down takes the pile, Space asks; when discarding, Space discards and up knocks.
